name: Blaudu Octus
description: Blaudu Octus was a planet in the Regulan system, near Blaudu Sextus. It was home to the Octusi species, a semi-sentient species who lived as willing servants to the people of Blaudu Sextus until Freedom Flight stirred a revolt amongst the Octusi in 44 ABY.
lead_paragraphs: Blaudu Octus was a planet in the Regulan system, near Blaudu Sextus. It was home to the Octusi species, a semi-sentient species who lived as willing servants to the people of Blaudu Sextus until Freedom Flight stirred a revolt amongst the Octusi in 44 ABY.
